criteria.text: GET /agent-org-proposals?status=proposed lists the queue (high-risk only; low-risk never appears as proposed).
criteria.test_id: issue-826-c1: GET ?status=proposed lists only proposed rows (low-risk applied row excluded)

criteria.text: POST /agent-org-proposals/:id/approve runs the matching apply step -> applied (then measuring for measurable kinds) -> records decided_by_user_id.
criteria.test_id: issue-826-c2: approve transitions proposed -> applied and records decided_by_user_id

criteria.text: POST /agent-org-proposals/:id/reject -> rejected, recorded in the dedup seen-set.
Approve is refused (4xx) for external-adoption without provenance_json, or for webhook-wiring without the security note (requiresSecurityNote).
criteria.test_id: issue-826-c4: approve refused (4xx) for external-adoption without provenance_json

criteria.text: Approve is refused (4xx) for webhook-wiring without the security note (requiresSecurityNote).
criteria.test_id: issue-826-c5: approve refused (4xx) for webhook-wiring without the required security note

criteria.text: Approve re-validates the change at apply time (names subset of live for agent/scope; auth+depth for delegation; HMAC/SSRF for webhook) and rejects if invalid.
criteria.test_id: issue-826-c6: approve re-validates change_json at apply time and rejects an invalid change

criteria.text: Endpoints respect the local agent-server auth model (AGENT_LOCAL bypass scoped to localhost - never exposed externally).
criteria.test_id: issue-826-c7: AGENT_LOCAL bypass — no bearer token required for queue endpoints

criteria.text: Policy update (2026-07-02): the review queue is the exception path (new-agent + external proposals) plus an audit-trail/rollback view of auto-applied ones, not the default approval path.
criteria.reason: Architectural/policy framing criterion, not independently testable beyond c1-c7 (queue only ever contains proposed-status rows; other statuses are read via existing listByStatusAsync for audit-trail purposes).
